name: WNMU Programming Library
notes: Revised v1.5.125 modular workspace correction: filter controls now have one layout owner, with static HTML placement and workspace-only geometry; shared layout routines opt out. Topic exclusion uses an explicit dropdown-render event instead of a document-wide observer, and Rights Begin/End uses static markup plus the shared sort system. Episodes Clear, Rights Clear, Clear all filters, Active/Archived, and Series/All/Pgm remain stable and non-overlapping. Program search starts automatically after 4 characters and a 2-second pause. Library titles open on the first click. Admin mode always shows Add New Program whenever no existing title is selected; the Select a program message is read-only only.
